svg.text: Magic Wand pen: side section and top view
Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense Rev2 (45 x 18 mm), FSR 400 squeeze sensor, D2 thumb button, 1-cell LiPo + TP4056 charger + 5 V boost
VIEW 1: LONGITUDINAL SECTION ON THE CENTRE PLANE (tip left, USB end right; dashed = off-plane parts)
FSR 400 + puck, under the index finger
Nano 33 BLE Sense Rev2 on side rails (no pin headers)
micro-USB FPC extension to DATA port
BMI270 + BMM150 IMU, ≈ 45 mm behind the FSR
wire channel under the PCB and battery
VIEW 2: TOP VIEW (outside). Section cuts A–D and rear view E are on sheet 2.
10 mm wide flat, 1 mm deep, with Ø8.4 x 0.5 FSR pocket
FSR centre from the tip (FORCE_SENSOR.md: 2–4 cm)
Magic Wand pen, rev A sketch, 2026-11-08. All dimensions in mm. Not to scale when printed; use the numbers.
